information.description:
Militech's classic Enforcer, retooled for streets the Enforcer couldn't handle. It's tougher and meaner, costs more in materials, and gives up any pretense of less-lethal work.

Cost: 23,600eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 61 ([2d6/2 Round Up] + 17d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: MonoVision
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle, Audio Recorder, Heavy Subdermal Plating (w/ Para Bellum [+1 SP, SP14 Total]), (-3(1d6) Humanity Loss) Hidden Holster, Low Light/Infrared/UV, Projectile Launch System, Popup Melee Weapon (Electric Baton), Self-ICE ×2, Subdermal Grip, Targeting Scope, Titanium Bones, Voice Stress Analyzer

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
